'''Fernando Castañón''' played the [[2020 World Championship]] (eighth on Day 3), the [[2022 European Championship]], the [[2023 European Championship]] and the [[2024 Regional Championships]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-world-championships/ 2020 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
